messages:
maya_support: Hey team — customer reported toolcall failures when calling our 'charge_customer' function. They see a 400 schema validation error. Pasting their request + error below. Need a quick triage.

maya_support: Request (redacted):
```json
POST /v1/invoke
{
  "tool": "charge_customer",
  "args": {
    "customer_id": 73123,
    "amount": "49.99",
    "currency": "USD",
    "billing_profile": {"legacy_id": "bp_12"},
    "session": null
  }
}
```

maya_support: Response: 400 Bad Request
```json
{
  "error": "Function schema validation failed",
  "details": [
    {"path": "/args/customer_id", "message": "expected string but got integer"},
    {"path": "/args/amount", "message": "expected number but got string"},
    {"path": "/args", "message": "additionalProperties not allowed: billing_profile"}
  ]
}
```

carlos_eng: Thanks. Does the customer call our hosted API or Dedicated?

maya_support: Hosted (api-redwood-prod region-us). They said it started with a recent SDK update but also repros with raw curl.

oliver_platform: Those errors look like two issues: type mismatches (customer_id/amount) and our function schema currently disallows additionalProperties — looks like billing_profile is not allowed in the v2 schema. We tightened the schema in last deploy (2024-10-02).

ryan_sre: @deploy-bot can you confirm which commit changed the charge_customer function schema?

deploy-bot: deploy info: service=functions-registry commit=7f9a2c3 schema/charge_customer.json updated (2024-10-02) by carlos_eng.

carlos_eng: Yup that was my change to enforce strict args for PCI compliance. I might have been too strict - looks like legacy integrations still send billing_profile.

maya_support: Customer says they can't change payload quickly. Any short-term compatibility option?

oliver_platform: We can do a quick middleware on the gateway to coerce types and strip/accept additionalProperties for known legacy keys. Suggestion: accept numeric customer_id -> coerce to string, parse amount string to number, and accept billing_profile as opaque object (but sanitize before passing to billing backend).

carlos_eng: Agreed. Quick patch: update validator to run a permissive pre-processor that normalizes types for these three fields and allow billing_profile during a 2-week compatibility window. I'll open a PR and request hotfix deploy.

maya_support: I'll reply to the customer with workaround ETA. Also asked them for the request-id header and example curl to attach to the ticket.

ryan_sre: Keep an eye on logs for any rate of these failures. If we see spike, we may need to enable fallback routing to Dedicated for affected customers to avoid blocking them.

carlos_eng: PR opened: https://git.internal/rw/infra/commit/fea1b2d (hotfix) — validation preprocessor + unit tests. Planning canary to 10% then full rollout.

maya_support: Thanks — forwarded to customer. They confirmed they can temporarily include customer_id as string. If we can do hotfix tonight that's ideal.

oliver_platform: I'll watch the canary and rollback plan is ready. Note: we should also update our SDK changelog calling out the stricter schema and migration steps so this doesn't recur.

carlos_eng: Filed ticket RW-4521 to follow up with a permanent schema migration + changelog.

maya_support: Closing loop with customer once canary is stable. Will post update here. :thumbsup:

maya_support: Update 2087654360 — Canary at 10% shows errors dropped to zero for this customer. Moving to 100% rollout now.

oliver_platform: 100% deployed, monitoring. All green.

maya_support: Customer confirmed successful charge in their next attempt. Marking resolved.

ryan_sre: Nice. Follow-up action: add a compatibility test to our pre-commit suite that runs example legacy payloads against new schemas.

carlos_eng: Agreed — added to RW-4521. Thanks all.
